answer: A parser bounty escrows 10 credits for one fixed code commit and network inlet. A sandbox must reproduce a crash on the literal input ember and a clean parse of opal as a control. An atomic paid flag releases the escrow only to the first verified claimant; 100 aliases cannot extract more than the same 10 credits. This removes duplicate-claim rewards, but stolen proofs can win the race and the narrow test leaves other defects unrewarded.
